title: SSH stream cancellation leaks completed forwards and accepts work after unconfirmed cleanup
cause: The post-forward cancellation check ran outside reservation rollback. Cleanup swallowed mux cancellation failure and failed to invalidate a reusable master after cancellation or socket-path removal failed.
implementation: Include post-command cancellation in rollback; invalidate and terminate the native master after unconfirmed rollback, join native observation, preserve independent failures and retain private evidence when native cleanup cannot be confirmed. Normal enclosing consumer cleanup avoids joining its own owner.
